## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 11/11 sectors positive on a 1W basis, but Technology and Energy are down 14.80% and 10.84% over 1M, respectively; mixed timeframes support the supplied regime, not a stronger call. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology in the Top 5), a concentration caution.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Communication leads on the weekly average (+5.64%); CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +17.89%). Materials (+4.87%) and Consumer Discretionary (+4.60%) follow; F ABOVE TREND (1W: +9.70% | 1M: +4.43%) and NKE ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.71% | 1M: +0.46%).

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Energy is weakest on the 1W sector average (+0.55%), followed by Utilities (+1.26%) and Technology (+1.48%); all three sectors were still positive for the week. Within Technology, AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) and AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%) show pronounced weakness.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%), IBM RECOVERY (1W: +10.81% | 1M: -1.35%), QCOM RECOVERY (1W: +10.65% | 1M: -2.02%), ACN RECOVERY (1W: +10.64% | 1M: -0.64%). Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology); the weekly surge is not yet confirmed by monthly performance for four names.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%), INTU BELOW TREND (1W: -12.28% | 1M: -17.14%), AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%), LRCX BELOW TREND (1W: -5.40% | 1M: -24.08%), and AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -22.47%). Weakness is concentrated in Technology.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Best 1W momentum: CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%), PLTR RECOVERY (1W: +12.03% | 1M: -12.52%), and IBM RECOVERY (1W: +10.81% | 1M: -1.35%). Major divergence across large stocks—including NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) and JPM RECOVERY (1W: +0.86% | 1M: -4.82%)—makes this a transitional tape; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Weekly sector average was positive, but the 1M average was -14.80%; sector-level stock breadth counts were not provided. AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +4.36%) and META ABOVE TREND (1W: +5.49% | 1M: +2.69%) contrast with MSFT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.09% | 1M: -7.01%), NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%), and GOOGL RECOVERY (1W: +0.84% | 1M: -15.37%).

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials gained 2.17% on the week but were down 0.44% over the month, a mixed backdrop rather than broad confirmation. V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%) and MA ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.46% | 1M: +9.28%) lead the supplied names, while JPM RECOVERY (1W: +0.86% | 1M: -4.82%) and GS BELOW TREND (1W: -4.09% | 1M: -12.14%) lag.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare gained 3.63% for the week and 0.77% for the month; sector-level stock breadth counts were not provided. AMGN ABOVE TREND (1W: +8.66% | 1M: +5.53%) and LLY ABOVE TREND (1W: +3.05% | 1M: +8.21%) show strength, while UNH RECOVERY (1W: +6.33% | 1M: -13.68%) remains a short-term bounce against a weak monthly trend.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Keep positioning selective: the 11/11 positive weekly sector breadth is constructive, but narrow Top 5 leadership and major 1W/1M divergences argue against a strong style bet. Style mixed / no clear leadership; monitor CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%), while limiting exposure to Technology laggards such as AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Watch for follow-through in CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +17.89%); both have positive weekly and monthly trends. BEARISH: AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) and AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%) remain at risk unless weekly weakness eases.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Communication (+5.64% 1W; +13.78% 1M) and Consumer Discretionary (+4.60% 1W; +5.43% 1M) have positive sector averages across both periods. BEARISH: Technology (+1.48% 1W; -14.80% 1M) and Energy (+0.55% 1W; -10.84% 1M) show weak monthly follow-through; sector stock breadth counts were not supplied.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Absolute price levels were not provided, so monitor trend confirmation instead: NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) needs sustained weekly strength, while AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) and AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%) need to arrest their declines. CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) is a continuation watch after its strong advance.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
TTWO (+45): GTA VI release catalyst; price confirms the news with TTWO ABOVE TREND (1W: +10.34% | 1M: +17.89%). UNH (+45): guidance-raise coverage; UNH RECOVERY (1W: +6.33% | 1M: -13.68%) shows a short-term bounce, but monthly weakness leaves confirmation incomplete. EQIX (+45): raised guidance; EQIX BELOW TREND (1W: -3.26% | 1M: -1.77%), a positive-news/weak-price divergence to monitor.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AMAT (-50): downgrade after record results; price confirms weakness with AMAT BELOW TREND (1W: -4.98% | 1M: -22.47%). AMD (-45): valuation downgrade; AMD BELOW TREND (1W: -13.22% | 1M: -26.61%) confirms price weakness. AVGO (-45): reported Google chip-order cut; AVGO BELOW TREND (1W: -9.90% | 1M: -11.22%) also confirms weakness, while AAPL (-30) AI-device competition news diverges from AAPL ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.67% | 1M: +4.36%).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime, with style mixed / no clear leadership; breadth is 11/11 sectors positive on the week, but Top 5 leadership is narrow (4/5 Technology). CHTR ABOVE TREND (1W: +15.54% | 1M: +46.00%) and V ABOVE TREND (1W: +6.79% | 1M: +7.43%) show relative strength. Major 1W/1M divergences in large stocks and bearish Technology sentiment warrant monitoring, especially as NVDA RECOVERY (1W: +3.09% | 1M: -30.13%) remains far below its monthly trend.
